key_insight: MAGIC turns a single text prompt into a fully connected multi-scene game world by explicitly planning and validating portals, not just generating scenes one by one.
engineering_relevance: It reduces the manual burden of authoring multi-level game environments while improving cross-scene consistency and navigability for runnable projects.
method: Plan a shared transition-aware intermediate representation for all scenes.
Generate each scene with flood-fill validation to ensure portal reachability.
Assemble scenes and transition scripts into one executable multi-scene project.
evidence_signal: On a 100-case benchmark, MAGIC produced an executable project for every case and achieved 0.99 precision, 0.95 recall, and 0.96 F1 for end-to-end transition identification.
watch_item: Results depend on accurate portal planning and validation, so errors in intermediate representation or transition scripts could still break consistency in more complex worlds.
paper_title: MAGIC: Transition-Aware Generation of Navigable Multi-Scene Game Worlds with Large Language Models
